author: ANKUR PANDEY
text:
📢 Faculty Recruitment 2026 | Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering & Technology (Autonomous), Coimbatore
Are you a passionate academician or technical professional looking for an opportunity to contribute to teaching, innovation, and industry-oriented learning? Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering and Technology (SIET), Coimbatore is inviting applications for multiple Faculty and Technical Positions for 2026.
🎓 Open Positions:
• Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor
• German / Mandarin Language Trainer
• Robotics & Automation Engineer
• PCB Assembly Line Engineer
📚 Departments & Areas:
💻 Computer Science & Engineering
🤖 Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
📊 Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
🔐 Cyber Security
💡 Information Technology
📖 English
🍱 Food Technology
🩺 Biomedical Engineering
⚙️ Robotics & Automation
🔌 PCB Assembly & Electronics Manufacturing
✅ Eligibility Highlights:
🔹 CSE / IT / AI & ML / AI & DS / Cyber Security:
M.E./M.Tech in relevant specialization preferred; industry experts with strong technical expertise may also be considered.
🔹 English:
M.A. English with SLET/NET qualification or Ph.D. preferred.
🔹 Food Technology & Biomedical Engineering:
M.E./M.Tech and Ph.D. as per Anna University norms.
🔹 Robotics & Automation:
B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech with hands-on experience in robotics, PLC, automation, IoT, ROS, embedded systems, or machine vision.
🔹 PCB Assembly Line Engineer:
Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in ECE, EEE, Electronics, Instrumentation, or related fields with practical industry experience.
🌐 Language Trainer Requirements:
• German: Goethe-Zertifikat C1/C2 or equivalent
• Mandarin: HSK Level 5/6 preferred with teaching certification
💼 Key Responsibilities:
✔️ Deliver quality teaching and technical training
✔️ Mentor students through practical and project-based learning
✔️ Support research, innovation, and industry collaboration
✔️ Contribute to institutional academic growth
🏫 About SIET:
Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering and Technology is an Autonomous institution approved by AICTE, affiliated to Anna University, and accredited by NAAC ‘A’ Grade and NBA, offering a strong environment for academic and professional development.
📍 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
📅 Last Date to Apply: 10 August 2026
📩 Apply via Email:
principal@siet.ac.in
chairman@siet.ac.in
If you are looking to be part of an institution focused on innovation, research, and industry-ready education, this opportunity is worth exploring.
Share with academicians and professionals who may be interested.
